summary: KONGSHEM CONSULTING AS (org. no. 990 970 408) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-03-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 0 and net income was NOK 245 108. CEO: Torstein Didrik Kongshem; board chair: Gunvor Alderslyst. Also: LEI 549300HNJWOOVZE1Y119.
